snippet.title: Undercurrent - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Undercurrent is a psychological sci-fi horror game set in 2250. You are a diplomat in interstellar negotiations when a remote station on an ocean world goes quiet. Your brother works there, so you make sure the mission is yours. Something inside is wrong. The longer you stay, the less of yourself is left.

#gametrailers #gameannouncement #gaming
